summary: Build practical conflict resolution skills, conversation plans, and accountability tools in 5 days. Enroll your team today.
lede: Workplace conflict resolution training helps professionals assess disputes and prepare structured conversations before tensions escalate. It is for team leaders, managers, HR and project professionals who need to address workplace disagreements using conflict-style diagnostics, active listening and neutral language. Participants practise interest-based negotiation, plan difficult conversations, and record agreements with action items and follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to handle tense workplace dialogue with structure, confidence, and accountability.
prerequisites: Prerequisites for this course are an intermediate level of workplace experience and regular involvement in team coordination, feedback, performance discussions, project delivery, or employee relations. You do not need formal mediation training, and no coding or technical software skills are required. Familiarity with basic conflict situations, supervisory responsibilities, or cross-functional collaboration will help you apply the exercises quickly.
